name: Nuts and Bolts Thief Master 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Nuts and Bolts Thief Master is a puzzle game where you step into the shoes of a cunning thief on a daring mission. Your objective is to crack open high-security vaults filled with riches by solving intricate nuts and bolts puzzles before the police catch you.
